why: The sibling half of issue #531, in the signal `snap` and `enteredRound` now share. Reverting to the inference leaves `snap` blind to a level switch between two worlds that both still carry `createWorld`'s `roundStartTick: 1`, so the tank is lerped from the previous board's coordinates to the new spawn for a frame -- the exact streak the comment above the lerp claims to have covered -- and the player's entrance ring, keyed to the same flag, is skipped entirely on that transition while playing on every other level switch. Both consequences are pinned, because a fix to only one of them would look complete.
killedBy: entity views — interpolation discontinuities snaps across an announced level switch, whose worlds agree on roundStartTick (#531)
spawn animation (#199) starts the entrance on an announced level switch, whose worlds agree on roundStartTick (#531)
